name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
provider: Department of Higher Education, Government of India
eligibility: Students who passed Class 12 with high marks and are studying in a recognized college or university

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
eligibility: Scheduled Caste students studying after Class 10 with eligible family income criteria

name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
amount: Up to ₹10,000 per year depending on the course
eligibility: OBC students pursuing studies after Class 10 with family income within the prescribed limit

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMS)
provider: Ministry of Education, Government of India
eligibility: Meritorious students from economically weaker families studying in Class 8 and continuing secondary education

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
provider: AICTE
eligibility: Girl students admitted to AICTE-approved technical diploma or degree courses

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship
provider: AICTE
eligibility: Differently-abled students with at least 40% disability studying in AICTE-approved institutions

name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme
provider: AICTE
eligibility: Students who are orphans, children of single parents, or affected by COVID-19 and studying in AICTE-approved institutions

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
provider: Department of Science and Technology, Government of India
eligibility: Top-performing science students pursuing BSc, BS, or Integrated MSc in basic and natural sciences

name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme
provider: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
eligibility: Dependent wards and widows of ex-servicemen, CAPF, and Assam Rifles personnel pursuing professional or technical education

name: National Overseas Scholarship
provider: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
category: SC / Denotified Tribes / Landless Agricultural Labourers / Traditional Artisans
amount: Covers tuition fees, living expenses, and other approved costs
eligibility: Eligible category students pursuing higher studies abroad in approved institutions

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
eligibility: Scheduled Caste students studying in Class 9 or 10 in a recognized school

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
eligibility: OBC students studying in a recognized school with family income within the prescribed limit

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
eligibility: Students with at least 40% disability studying in Class 9 or 10 in a recognized school

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
eligibility: Students with at least 40% disability pursuing studies after Class 10

name: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
amount: Full tuition fee + living allowance up to ₹86,000 per year
eligibility: SC students admitted to premier institutions such as IITs, NITs, IIMs, and other approved institutes

name: Top Class Education for Students with Disabilities
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
amount: Tuition fee reimbursement + maintenance allowance up to ₹2,00,000
eligibility: Students with at least 40% disability studying in recognized higher education institutions

name: National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
eligibility: Scheduled Caste students pursuing full-time MPhil or PhD in recognized universities or institutions

name: National Fellowship for OBC Students
provider: Government of India
eligibility: OBC students pursuing research leading to MPhil or PhD in recognized universities

name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses
provider: Ministry of Minority Affairs
amount: Course fee up to ₹20,000 per year + maintenance allowance
eligibility: Minority community students pursuing professional or technical courses with at least 50% marks and eligible family income

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship
provider: Ministry of Minority Affairs
eligibility: Girl students belonging to notified minority communities studying in Class 9 to 12 in recognized schools
